name: custom_gel_cylinder_100mm_press_slide_x
parameter_origin: Illustrative synthetic values; a rigid reference geometry, not a named commercial material.
material_label: Rigid smooth cylinder, 100 mm diameter, on the tapered pad, axis along x
model_notes: Same object, load and 4 mm protocol as the nominal-pad case of this diameter; the sensor is a quarter turn round and the pad is the tapered one, so the pair isolates what the pad and its orientation change.
The contact line runs the 22 mm side of the 22 x 16 mm sensing face, against the 16 mm side in the y-slide suite, so the same 4 N is carried by a longer line.
The pad is 5 mm thick against the nominal 4 mm, which softens it: travel under the same load is a result to read, not a setting to compare.
